_comment: The pages a visitor can read on the static site. The sitemap lists them (src/app/sitemap.ts) and the site search indexes them (scripts/build-search-index.mjs). A title or description that is a key in src/messages/en/*.json is searched in every language; `areas` adds every string of those message areas as the page's text.

pages.title: European Health Data Space
pages.description: An open-source reference implementation of the European Health Data Space (Regulation (EU) 2025/327): seven roles, 127 synthetic patients, one knowledge graph.

pages.title: Demo
pages.description: Explore the Health Dataspace as any of the 7 demo participants, no login required.
